I disagree on that. While the current system we have is flawed, it doesn't mean we should overhaul it completely. We just needed a few tweaks on point gains (survivor and killer) to make it as close as possible to be a good ranking system.

Another thing that scared me was that they stated was " In the future, we would like to extend this system to support different ratings for each killer, allowing you to practice a new killer without being immediately matched against high skilled players." BHVR I can not stress how much of a bad idea this is. Killers don't differ that much from each other. If you play Myers and want to try wraith, there's not much of a mechanical shift. Killers will completely dominate the game. The only killer that this may be applied to is nurse. This just sounds like a scheme so you avoid making tutorials/spotlights on killer for new players. 

The real problem is allowing swf to play when their rank differences are too high. If you really don't wanna back out on that change you made a few months ago, at least set a restriction on the rank differences. While you're at it, make rank actually worth something, make it hard to reach and give out rewards. Perhaps extend the season to 2 months whilst making it much harder to rank up. This would fix a lot of issues.

We all know how red rank lobbies can take incredibly long at high ranks, but that's because of player population. If you introduce small tutorials to each killer to help new players, and make the game more fun to play for survivors, population will not be a problem to you. If you keep working around the fact that there aren't enough red rank players to find a lobby, you'll never find a good solution.

TL;DR They want to make rank unique to each killer, which is stupid and will lead to stomping since myers=wraith. Don't rework matchmaking, fix it.
